_doc: v124 LOCAL-ONLY restricted-loader config TEMPLATE. This file is safe to commit (it contains no private paths and no copyrighted text). To use the local restricted loader on your OWN machine: copy this file to data/_restricted/restricted_local_config.json (that path is gitignored), set `enabled` to true, and place lawfully-obtained restricted source files under data/_restricted/. NEVER commit the activated config or any restricted text. The public GitHub Pages archive ignores all of this and stays metadata-only.

activation.requireOptIn: Set localStorage 'digitalArchive.localRestricted' = 'true' OR open the app with ?localRestricted=1. GitHub Pages (github.io) is hard-blocked and can never enable local mode.
activation.failClosed: If this config is absent, disabled, or the host is not local, the app behaves exactly like the public metadata-only archive.

notes: Copy to data/_restricted/restricted_local_config.json locally; do not commit it.
Restricted source text lives only under data/_restricted/ (gitignored).
Public archive never includes restricted text, OCR, PDFs, or scans.
Local restricted text is always visually marked 'Local restricted copy' and is never counted toward the public Muktikā 108 figure.
